method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reverse reconstruction of the part-level scope and conditional source behavior, comparison with the already translated propositional-logic part driver, and exact formula, macro, controlled-token, import, tag and identifier comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: The First-order Logic part title, its editorial account of metatheoretic coverage and FOL-tag behavior, and all eleven chapter imports with their proof-system guards.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The part develops the metatheory of first-order logic through completeness without relying on a separate propositional treatment. When FOL is false, quantified material is omitted and structures are replaced by valuations; most propositional material is the same source with that tag disabled.
samples.checks: First-order logic, metatheory, completeness, the independence claim, proof status, quantifier exclusion, structure-to-valuation replacement, both displayed macros and the false-tag condition are retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Including the propositional part currently causes substantial repetition. A planned source arrangement would allow this part to account for prior propositional material, omit what is already covered, and shorten proofs by cross-reference.
samples.checks: The present repetition, future-plan modality, exclusion of covered material and proof-shortening by references to corresponding propositional locations are all preserved.

source_observations: The target uses the established अधिउपपत्ती, प्रथम-क्रम तर्कशास्त्र, विधानीय तर्कशास्त्र, संपूर्णता, संख्यापक and सत्य-मूल्यांकन decisions rather than introducing part-driver synonyms.
The English words structure and valuation remain inside controlled glossary markers exactly as required, while the surrounding Marathi states the direction of replacement unambiguously.
All eleven imports, four conditional proof-system guards, formulas, macros, controlled tokens, identifiers and relative import options match exactly.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The editorial describes planned upstream refactoring rather than a mathematical result; the target preserves that prospective status.
The imported beyond chapter remains untranslated at this checkpoint and is not represented as reader-complete.
